evidence_quotes.agenda: 'Before I discuss with you the pricing structure and the estimates, do you have any concern about the moving process or any worries that you'd like to talk about?' — asked, but only after full logistics probing (address, POD size, items, floor) was already done.
evidence_quotes.two_layers_deep: Customer answered 'No' — 15/15 via the no-concern-raised exception.
evidence_quotes.save_your_ass: 'If ever the move takes less than this you will only be charged for how much time we used' present; no rate/experience, self-prep, or fair-check.

top_strength: Caught and gracefully corrected her own pod-size math error mid-call (customer clarified 2x7.5ft vs 17ft), then re-quoted cleanly and booked the customer.
coaching_note: Move the agenda question to before logistics probing starts to get full 10pts instead of 4, and add at least one of the four differentiators.
